page.overview:
Who is Crassik?

Crassik was a Skaven of Under-Sartosa sent to steal a magic amulet from the merchant Ambrosio Vento during the siege of Sartosa.

He's not particularly intelligent. He was pushed towards Gotrek and Felix by his litter brother Siskritt, thus condemning him to certain death.
